info.title: Stuqet Mobile API
info.description:
Customer, seller, and delivery mobile APIs.

1. Obtain the System-Key from the backend team and enter it under Authorize.
2. POST /api/v2/auth/login with login_by, email (also used for phone login), password, and user_type: customer, seller, or delivery_boy.
3. Copy access_token from the response into BearerAuth (without the Bearer prefix).
4. Use App-Language for localization.

Shared customer endpoints also provide catalog and configuration data for other apps. Some routes depend on enabled add-ons or payment-provider configuration. Try it out performs real requests, including mutations: use a test account and staging data. Request schemas discovered from source are partial; login, signup, and delivery-status payloads have explicit examples. Unavailable route handlers are listed separately and excluded from executable operations. No credentials are embedded in this document.
